name: Ledger keeps its filters and page after a reload
description: A filtered, paged ledger view is written into the link and survives a full page reload.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
Assert the browser tab title is exactly "Alibi · said vs did"
In the select labelled Verdict choose "No record"
Click the "Next →" button twice
Assert the pager text starts with "Page 3 of"
Assert the address bar URL ends with "#/claims?verdict=no_record&page=3"
Reload the page and wait for the list of claims to load
Assert the Verdict select still shows "No record" and the pager text still starts with "Page 3 of"
Assert every visible claim row carries the "No record" verdict tag

name: Back from a claim returns to the same filtered ledger page
description: Opening a claim from a filtered second page and pressing the browser Back button lands on the same filters and page.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
In the select labelled Verdict choose "Contradicted"
Click the "Next →" button once
Assert the pager text starts with "Page 2 of" and note the text of the first claim row
Click the first claim row to open the claim page
Assert the claim page shows a "Ledger" link above the claim and the address bar contains "#/claim/"
Press the browser Back button and wait for the list of claims to load
Assert the Verdict select shows "Contradicted", the pager text starts with "Page 2 of", and the first claim row has the same text as before

name: A shared ledger link opens the same filtered view
description: A ledger link with filters in it, opened fresh, applies every filter and search term.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims?agent=GPT-5.2&kind=relay directly as a fresh page load and wait for the claims to load
Assert the Agent select shows "GPT-5.2" and the Kind select shows "relay"
Assert the "matching claims" count is smaller than 7,118
Assert every visible claim row names the agent GPT-5.2 and the kind relay

name: A stale ledger link falls back to the full ledger
description: A link naming a verdict and a day the data doesn't have, and a negative page, shows the whole ledger rather than an empty one.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims?verdict=bogus&day=1999-01-01&page=-4 directly as a fresh page load and wait for the page to load
Assert the Verdict select shows "All verdicts" and the Day select shows "All days"
Assert the page shows "7,118 matching claims" and does not show "No claims match these filters"
Assert the pager text starts with "Page 1 of"

name: The Ledger nav link clears every filter
description: From a filtered ledger, the Ledger link in the top bar returns to the full, unfiltered ledger.

planSteps.description: Open /#/claims and wait for the list of claims to load
In the select labelled Kind choose "verification" and type "donation" into the search box
Assert the "matching claims" count is smaller than 7,118
Click "Ledger" in the top navigation bar
Assert the Kind select shows "All kinds", the search box is empty, and the page shows "7,118 matching claims"
